items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was going to ask a little bit more about Arno De Pass... Was that called the Olympia or Young Olympia Band? [INTERVIEWEE] No, he called his band Olympia.

ctx.x: Well, I happened not to be working then. I had a job, but it was a part-time job. I was pressing, real pressing shop. And I only worked three days a week. And that was on the corner of Royal and Espanol.
I was going to ask a little bit more about Arno De Pass. Is it De Pass or De Pass? It's D-E. D-E, De Pass. Was that called the Olympia or Young Olympia Band?
No, he called his band Olympia.
